description_en: Retrieves the default synchronization region for external asset synchronization
description_zh: 云外资产同步获取默认同步region
name: GetLocalDefaultRegion

parameters.help_en:
The cloud asset vendor. Valid values:

Tencent: Tencent Cloud
HUAWEICLOUD: Huawei Cloud
Azure: Azure
AWS: AWS
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：

Tencent：腾讯云
HUAWEICLOUD：华为云
Azure：Azure
AWS：AWS
parameters.name: vendor

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Status.description_en:
The access type of the multi-cloud site. Valid values:
0: No default site exists. You can select one.
1: The current site is already the default site.
2: Another site is already set as the default site
Status.description_zh:
多云站点的接入类型。取值：
0：目前没有默认站点,可以正常勾选
1：当前站点已经是默认站点
2：另一个站点已经是设置为默认站点
